purpose: Research-only evaluation of regime-state approximation on real ES/NQ observations; not a trading or profitability test.

source_data.source_format: normalized 1-minute OHLCV archive; immutable individual listed futures contracts; no continuous-contract construction
source_data.contract_policy: Keep ES and NQ separate. Preserve each exact contract ticker and session identity. Never stitch, back-adjust, or silently merge contracts. Any per-date active-contract selection must use archived explicit roll facts and be recorded in derived provenance.

causality.feature_information_cutoff: observation timestamp inclusive; features may use only current and earlier observations in the same session, with synchronized counterpart observations timestamp <= cutoff
causality.normalization: Fit feature means/scales on TRAIN only; reuse unchanged on VALIDATION and OOS TEST.
causality.sequence_boundary: No sequence may cross a session or contract boundary. Target is the endpoint observation.

features.missing_value_policy: Do not impute from future data. Report per-feature missingness; exclude an observation from a model only when a required selected feature is unavailable. Fit any imputation value on TRAIN only.

targets.target_source: Phase 4 deterministic RegimeAssignment from the same endpoint causal feature row
targets.uncertain_policy: Preserve and report UNCERTAIN frequency; do not train on invalid/UNCERTAIN labels; report their exclusion count by split and instrument.
targets.scientific_caveat: Because labels are generated by the deterministic Phase 4 rule from the same features, supervised scores measure rule imitation, not independent future market prediction. This caveat is part of the interpretation gate.

models.description: Frozen Phase 4 deterministic classifier; no fitting.
Existing fixed causal temporal transform followed by same-width NumPy multihead classifier; no new architecture or learned convolution kernels.

chronological_split.split_unit: chronological trading date, independently per instrument

evaluation.calibration: Temperature scaling fitted on VALIDATION only; report raw and calibrated OOS separately.

abstention.uncertainty_order: ascending normalized predictive entropy; fixed before evaluation

shuffle_control.permutation_unit: within instrument and session; permute TRAIN labels only; evaluate on untouched OOS labels

evaluation.acceptance_rule: No retrospective threshold changes. Classify A/B/C/D from per-head, per-instrument and per-window evidence; any leakage signal halts validation. Classification metrics do not imply trading performance.

manifest_hashing: SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and compact separators, excluding no fields; source archive hashes remain as listed above.
